evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Reef-monitoring satellites could also be used to report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), explicit users (marine/conservation scientists), strong rationale with cited literature on bleaching, reef size, and Asner's imaging technique. Requirements not yet formalised, but concept and need are well established.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page.
Week 10 is reserved for review, amendments, final simulations, and reflection.

criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt chart with weekly tasks, colour-coded status, deadlines, and task-by-task narrative tied to mission needs (launch, orbit, ground control, comms). However, no explicit contingency/variation provision, which the Accomplished descriptor requires; hence lower end of band.

evidence.quote: I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity

criteria.reasoning: Evidence of progress is background research and STK tutorials only; no preliminary technical results, calculations, orbit or payload figures are presented or interpreted. On track, but technical output is minor.

evidence.quote: Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

criteria.reasoning: Well-written, clear structure with headings, good Gantt figure. But references are bare URLs as footnotes with no formal reference list, and in-text citation style is inconsistent; 'Useful Links' section is informal. Falls short of professional referencing standard.

technical_issues.issue: Claims near-real-time relay without discussing orbit/coverage implications (e.g. LEO revisit gaps vs GEO); feasibility not yet addressed.
No contingency planning for schedule slippage; 'End of Life' options listed without technical screening.

overall: Strong, well-referenced mission concept for GBR monitoring with a detailed Gantt plan and STK chosen. Preliminary technical work is thin (tutorials only), and referencing/presentation is informal rather than professional. Solid Part 1 submission.
